title: A check-in figure far above what the app had is asked about, not placed (final_review_1 watch item, decision O)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027, after pay on Fri 25 Dec. The bank holds 100,000 (30,000 of it Free to spend left), the e-wallet 5,000, the cash 10,000. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month. At the check-in on Fri 8 Jan at 20:00 the person types 101,000 for the bank, 280,000 for the e-wallet (the bank's figure typed in the wrong box) and 13,000 for the cash. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the bank's figure typed in the e-wallet's box

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The e-wallet shows 275,000 more than the 5,000 the app had: more than this period's Free to spend of 60,000, so it is asked about. The cash shows 3,000 more than 10,000: more than 20% of the account (2,000), so it is asked about too. The bank's 1,000 is below both (60,000 and 20,000), so it is not asked.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 280,000 (the figure typed stands as the bank figure until the person answers) = 280,000
